ops.name: Secret Santa Gift Exchange Kit
ops.description:
Run your Secret Santa or white elephant exchange without the stress. This printable kit has every page an organizer needs, from sign-up to the thank-you notes.

Perfect for offices, classrooms, clubs, friend groups and big families.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (11-page PDF)

  • How to use page with 4 simple steps
  • Organizer page (date, budget, drop-off spot) and sign-up sheet
  • Secret Santa questionnaire (14 questions: favorites, sizes, allergies, wish ideas)
  • Gift idea starter list by budget (under $10, $20, $30)
  • 24 name-draw slips to cut and fold
  • Secret Santa rules plus optional twists
  • White elephant rules and a dice swap game chart
  • Who has who tracker for the organizer
  • 12 cut-out gift tags
  • 6 thank-you notes

DETAILS
